about.body: The AJ300D is Jaguar Land Rover's Ingenium-family 3.0-litre straight-six diesel engine. It's a twin-turbocharged unit that entered production in 2019 and is paired with a 48V mild-hybrid system. Within the Jaguar range, the AJ300D is fitted exclusively to the F-Pace D300 — a single, specific application.

byModel.body: The AJ300D appears in one model: the F-Pace D300 (X761) . Across the F-Pace range, the D300 is the performance-oriented diesel option, using the 3.0-litre twin-turbo AJ300D with mild-hybrid assistance. This is the only Jaguar application for this engine.

compatibility.body: The AJ300D is used in a single Jaguar application — the F-Pace D300 — so compatibility is straightforward. However, the engine is part of a wider Ingenium family and is also used in Land Rover vehicles. Ancillaries, mounting, and ECU calibration differ between brands and models, so registration/VIN matching is still required before any rebuild or replacement is confirmed. For the F-Pace D300 specifically, the 48V MHEV system is integrated with the combustion engine.
